title: Tickets, and When Things Go Wrong
label: ch:bn-tickets-and-when-things-go-wrong
canDo: I can buy a ticket (ekṭā ṭikiṭ deben?), ask the fare and the time, report a lost bag or a missed train (hāriye gechhe, chheṛe gechhe), and read and write ৌ in নৌকা.

payoff.summary: Complete BN-R271-at-the-station: buy a ticket and report a problem.
